title: AI-native agency site config
description: Everything agency-specific for one generated site under sites/<slug>-web/. Fed to scripts/new-agency-site.mjs. See sites/_template-agency-web/README.md for the plain-language field guide.

slug.description: URL-safe identifier. The generator writes this site to sites/<slug>-web/ and names the Cloudflare Pages project <slug>-web.

default.description: Placeholder *.pages.dev domain used until a real domain is bound (HITL, see README). Every absolute URL derives from this.

brand.description: Optional. Falls back to the Protection Partners ink/brass palette if omitted -- see sites/_template-agency-web/src/styles/global.css defaults.

logo_path.description: Path under public/ to a logo image. Null = text wordmark (agency_name) only, which is the default and requires no asset.

display.description: Human-readable, e.g. '(321) 555-0100'. Use '[PHONE TBD]' if not yet assigned.

tel.description: tel: URI, e.g. 'tel:+13215550100'. This is also the VoiceWidget's fallback when Vapi env vars are unset.

licensed_states.description: Two-letter state codes this agency is licensed to write business in.

ams_vendor.description: Agency management system. 'ezlynx' enables the Client Center login link and the README's EZLynx-via-Canopy-Marketplace explainer. There is no code-level AMS API integration for any vendor -- see README.

client_center.description: Optional. Existing-client self-service portal link (e.g. EZLynx Client Center). Omit if the agency has none yet.

carriers_note.description: Copy for the homepage carriers placeholder row, e.g. '[CARRIER LOGOS PENDING APPOINTMENTS]'.

why_points.description: Short bullet list in the homepage hero side panel ('Why agencies like ours exist').

lines_of_business.description: One entry per line-of-business page. Rendered by the generic src/pages/[line].astro template -- no per-line page files needed.

hero_variant.description: Background of the top hero section.

hero_cta_variant.description: Button style of the hero section's Get a Quote CTA.

final_cta_variant.description: Background of the closing CTA section.

version.description: Versioned TCPA consent id, e.g. 'pp-tcpa-v1-2026-08-24'. Bump when text_template changes.

text_template.description: TCPA consent copy. Use the literal token {{agency_name}} where the agency name should be interpolated at build time.

canopy_connect.description: Optional. Omit entirely (or leave public_alias_env unset at runtime) to fall back to the plain intake form -- same gated-fallback pattern the v1 site used for Vapi.

public_alias_env.description: Env var holding the Canopy Connect 'publicAlias' (the /c/<alias> link segment from the Canopy dashboard's Links page). Client-safe by design -- it is already public in the shareable Canopy link.

dec_upload_url_env.description: Optional env var holding a Canopy-hosted 'Document Upload' sharing-path link (plan-tier dependent -- do not assume it exists). When set, DecUploadWidget links out to Canopy's own hosted upload flow instead of rendering the site's own upload form.

intake.description: Optional. Config-driven toggles for the secondary/fallback intake sharing paths that render beneath the primary Canopy Connect one-click CTA on / and /get-a-quote (issue #19602). Omitting this object, or any individual key, defaults that path to enabled.

decUpload.description: Declarations-page file upload (PDF/JPG/PNG). Writes protection_partners_intake rows with source='dec_upload'.

formEntry.description: Plain multi-step quote form, visually demoted below Canopy. Writes rows with source='form_entry'.

callback.description: Minimal name/phone/best-time capture. Writes rows with source='callback_request'.

firstTimeBuyer.description: 'Buying your first policy? Start here' path for prospects with no current policy to connect. Routes to the plain form with source='first_time_buyer'.

vapi.description: Optional. Omit / leave env vars unset to fall back to the tel: link.

supabase_table.description: Optional. Intake table name. Defaults to '<slug_with_underscores>_intake'. Must be created via a migration before go-live -- the generator does not create tables.

supabase_storage_bucket.description: Optional. Supabase Storage bucket name for the dec-page upload fallback path. Defaults to '<slug>-dec-uploads'. Must be created before go-live (Storage REST API or migration) -- the generator does not create buckets, same as supabase_table.

enabled.description: If true, the analytics snippet renders when PUBLIC_POSTHOG_KEY is set at build time.
